lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun mahi gunee samaae jis aap bujhaae laahaa bhagat saisaare ||
lines.translation: One's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord; he comes to understand his own self. He earns the profit of devotional worship in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhagatee sukh na hoee doojai pat khoee guramat naam adhaare ||
lines.translation: Without devotion, there is no peace; through duality, one's honor is lost, but under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with the Support of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਤੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: vakhar naam sadaa laabh hai jis no et vaapaar laae ||
lines.translation: He ever earns the profit of the merchandise of the Naam, whom the Lord employs in this Trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜੀਅਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ratan padaarath vanajeeahi jaa(n) satigur dei bujhaae ||1||
lines.translation: He purchases the jewel, the invaluable treasure, unto whom the True Guru has given this understanding. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh dukh hai khotaa ihu vaapaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣੀ ਬਹੁ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR bol bikh khaavanee bahu vadhahi vikaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: Speaking falsehood, one eats poison, and the evil within increases greatly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu vadhahi vikaaraa sahasaa ihu sa(n)saaraa bin naavai pat khoee ||
lines.translation: The evil within increases greatly, in this world of doubt; without the Name, one's honor is lost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit vaad vakhaanahi bin boojhe sukh na hoee ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying, the religious scholars argue and debate; but without understanding, there is no peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa kade na chookai maaiaa moh piaaraa ||
lines.translation: Their comings and goings never end; emotional attachment to Maya is dear to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh dukh hai khotaa ihu vaapaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: khote khare sabh parakheean tit sache kai darabaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: The counterfeit and the genuine are all assayed in the Court of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਨਿ ਊਭੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: khote daragah suteean oobhe karan pukaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: The counterfeit are cast out of the Court, and they stand there, crying out in misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਭੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: oobhe karan pukaaraa mugadh gavaaraa manamukh janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They stand there, crying out in misery; the foolish, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs have wasted their lives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa maaiaa jin jagat bhulaaiaa saachaa naam na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Maya is the poison which has deluded the world; it does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sa(n)taa naal vair kar dukh khate sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are resentful toward the Saints; they harvest only pain in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਵਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khote khare parakheean tit sachai daravaaraa raam ||3||
lines.translation: The counterfeit and the genuine are assayed in that True Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee raam ||
lines.translation: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit bhaavai tit laaisee jiu tis dee vadiaaee raam ||
lines.translation: As He pleases, He engages us; such is His glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਨ ਫੁਸੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu tis dee vadiaaee aap karaaee vareeaam na phusee koee ||
lines.translation: Such is His glorious greatness - He Himself causes all to act; no one is a warrior or a coward.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan daataa karam bidhaataa aape bakhase soee ||
lines.translation: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Architect of karma - He Himself grants forgiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaeeai naanak naam pat paaee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated, O Nanak, and through the Naam, honor is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee ||4||4||
lines.translation: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saudaa har naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: The True merchandise is the Lord's Name. This is the true trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਅਤਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee har naam vanajeeai at mol aphaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, we trade in the Lord's Name; its value is very great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਸਚ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਸਚਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: at mol aphaaraa sach vaapaaraa sach vaapaar lage vadabhaagee ||
lines.translation: The value of this true trade is very great; those who are engaged in the true trade are very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar bhagatee raate sach naam liv laagee ||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, they are imbued with devotion, and they enshrine love for the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare soee sach paae gur kai sabad veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Favor, obtains Truth, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate tin hee sukh paaiaa saachai ke vaapaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Name find peace; they deal only in the True Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)umai maaiaa mail hai maaiaa mail bhareejai raam ||
lines.translation: Egotistical involvement in Maya is filth; Maya is overflowing with filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee man niramalaa rasanaa har ras peejai raam ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, the mind is made pure and the tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa har ras peejai a(n)tar bheejai saach sabad beechaaree ||
lines.translation: The tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord, and deep within, the heart is drenched with His Love, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖੂਹਟਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਪੀਐ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar khoohataa a(n)mrit bhariaa sabade kaadh peeai panihaaree ||
lines.translation: Deep within, the well of the heart is overflowing with the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar; the water-carrier draws and drinks in the water of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis nadar kare soee sach laagai rasanaa raam raveejai ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's favor is attuned to the Truth; with his tongue, he chants the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਰ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate se niramal hor haumai mail bhareejai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are immaculate. The others are full of the filth of egotism. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੂਕਦੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit jotakee sabh paR paR kookade kis pahi karahi pukaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: All the religious scholars and astrologers read and study, and argue and shout. Who are they trying to teach?
